name: tiktokweb
description: Ghost 778 — TikTok hub, link hub and blog

scripts.build: npm run sync-meta && node scripts/store-apps.mjs && tsc -b && node scripts/stage-templates.mjs && vite build && node scripts/prerender.mjs && esbuild dist/store/store.js --minify --target=es2017 --legal-comments=none --allow-overwrite --outfile=dist/store/store.js
scripts.deploy:cf: npm run build && node scripts/cf-headers.mjs && rm -f dist/_redirects && npx -y wrangler@4 deploy
scripts.test: node scripts/test-bots.mjs && node scripts/test-whatsapp.mjs && node scripts/test-license.mjs && node scripts/test-bot-licensing.mjs && node scripts/test-store-app.mjs && node scripts/test-dash-app.mjs && node scripts/test-anthropic-proxy.mjs
